subject: Onboarding pause — request for demo buffer & trial top-up
messages:
From: Samira Nadeem <samira@accelecom.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Onboarding pause — request for demo buffer & trial top-up

Hi Markus / Laura,

Quick update from our engineering side: we hit a blocker in the connector that prevents us from completing the data mapping for the demo next week. The team traced it to a schema mismatch coming from our legacy pipeline; it'll take an estimated 10–12 business days to resolve and validate.

We're still committed to the POC but this shifts our demo window and the planned usage cadence. Two asks from our side:
- Can Redwood extend our trial window by ~3 weeks so we can re-schedule the live demo without losing momentum?
- Would you consider a one-time sandbox credit top-up to cover the follow-up validation runs once our engineers re-run the sync?

I've attached the short integration log and a screenshot of the failing call. If you need an engineering deep-dive, our lead (eng@accelecom.com) can hop on a 30-min call.

Thanks — appreciate a quick note on what you can do here.

Samira Nadeem
Head of Platform Partnerships
Accelecom

Attachments:
- integration-logs-0929.txt
- screenshot-error-connector.png

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Samira Nadeem <samira@accelecom.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-29T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding pause — request for demo buffer & trial top-up

Samira —

Thanks for the clear write-up and the logs. Short answer: yes, we can help. We're sensitive to demo schedules and don't want you to lose momentum. Proposed immediate steps: 

1) Provisional 21-day trial extension on your account so the demo can be moved without interruption.
2) One-time sandbox credit top-up (50k token-equivalent) to cover validation and replays while your team resolves the schema issue.

I need a quick sign-off from billing/legal for the top-up -- looping in Karthik (cc) to move that piece. Laura, can your CS lead prepare a revised demo slot and updated mutual action plan?

If Accelecom can confirm the new target demo week today, we can lock the extension and credit in the next 24 hours.

Best,
Markus Klein
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Note: provisional—finalized after finance approval.

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Samira Nadeem <samira@accelecom.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-29T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding pause — request for demo buffer & trial top-up

Markus / Samira —

Appreciate the context. From a billing/finance perspective I can approve a one-time sandbox top-up up to 60k token-equivalent for Accelecom for this POC, provided:
- Accelecom confirms a revised demo date within the next 7 days, and
- We receive a brief acknowledgment that Redwood will be the primary provider for the POC (email confirmation is fine) so we have the mutual action plan recorded.

I'll attach a short approval note once I've logged the transaction. Laura, please confirm whether we also need any SLA exceptions for this account during the extended period.

Karthik
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- approval-note.pdf

From: Samira Nadeem <samira@accelecom.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Accelecom Engineering <eng@accelecom.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-30T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding pause — request for demo buffer & trial top-up

Markus / Karthik / Laura —

Thank you — this is great news. Confirming Accelecom accepts the provisional terms: we'll pick a new demo week (targeting Oct 19–23) and Samir (cc'd from Eng) will own the technical validation. Please proceed with the 21-day extension + the 50k token sandbox credit; we'll follow up with the short confirmation email you requested.

Two small asks: if there is a DocuSign or simple acceptance form we should sign to record the credit and extension, please send it over and we'll return it same day.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

—Samira
Samira Nadeem
Head of Platform Partnerships, Accelecom
samira@accelecom.com
